devdoc.details: Events declared inside a library can be emitted directly by any      contract that imports it, via `InsuranceEvents.EventName(...)` — one      canonical definition instead of duplicating identical events across      DriverRegistry, InsurancePolicy, ClaimManager, and InsurancePool.

params.approvedBy: The insurance-company address that approved it.

params.rejectedBy: The address that rejected the claim.

params.policyId: The policy the claim is filed against.

params.pausedBy: The address that triggered the pause.

params.unpausedBy: The address that lifted the pause.

params.amount: The amount paid out, in wei.

params.cancelledBy: The address that initiated the cancellation.

params.coverage: The maximum payout coverage, in wei.
params.driver: The driver the policy belongs to.
params.expiryTime: The unix timestamp the policy expires.

params.driver: The driver wallet whose score was updated.

ClaimApproved(uint256,address).notice: Emitted when the insurance company approves a claim for payout.

ClaimRejected(uint256,string,address).notice: Emitted when a claim is rejected.

ClaimSubmitted(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted when a driver submits a new claim.

DriverRegistered(address,bytes32).notice: Emitted when a new driver registers with the platform.

EmergencyPaused(address).notice: Emitted when a contract is paused in response to an emergency.

EmergencyUnpaused(address).notice: Emitted when a contract is unpaused, resuming normal operations.

FundsDeposited(address,uint256).notice: Emitted when funds are deposited into the InsurancePool.

PayoutCompleted(uint256,address,uint256).notice: Emitted when a claim payout has been successfully transferred to the driver.

PolicyCancelled(uint256,address).notice: Emitted when a policy is cancelled by the driver or the insurer.

PolicyPurchased(uint256,address,uint256,.notice: Emitted when a driver purchases a new insurance policy.

PolicyRenewed(uint256,uint256,uint64).notice: Emitted when a policy is renewed.

PremiumUpdated(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Emitted whenever a policy's premium amount is recalculated or updated.

SafetyScoreUpdated(address,uint8).notice: Emitted when the oracle submits an updated safety score for a driver.

userdoc.notice: Centralized event definitions for the lean Driver Insurance protocol.
